title: Secrets Manager Stack Config
description: Schema for the secrets_manager_stack 'secrets' array. Each entry defines a Secrets Manager secret created with a placeholder value (seeded with the real value out-of-band). Template variables (e.g. {{WORKLOAD_NAME}}, {{ENVIRONMENT}}) are supported in string fields and resolved at synth time.

name.description: Secret name/path. Supports template variables such as {{WORKLOAD_NAME}} and {{ENVIRONMENT}}.

description.description: Human-readable description of the secret's purpose.

placeholder.description: Initial placeholder value written at create. NEVER change this after the first deploy or CloudFormation will overwrite the out-of-band seeded value. Default: REPLACE_ME.

removal_policy.description: Removal policy. RETAIN (default) keeps the secret when the stack is deleted so credentials are not lost. DESTROY deletes it with the stack.
